Name: Pam's Clean House
Author: bonecharm
Description:
Feeling disappointed that you built Pam a beautiful new house only to discover it dirty the next day? Because I sure do.

This is a very simple mod that gets rid of the beer bottles in Pam's bedroom. It replaces the Trailer_big.tbin file so any other mods using that map will conflict with this mod.

This requires Content Patcher and SMAPI to run.
